1981-2415-4699-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-4699-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

277-2577-7084-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

333-6495-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-6495-7424.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
333-6495-7424.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-2781-2947.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Vesperlark.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Vesperlark.
When Vesperlark leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

628-4247-6672.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

1170-3698-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3698-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

5170-5686-6132-7574.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3375-3641-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-3641-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

223-2655-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-2655-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Fury Storm by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Fury Storm targeting the original Fury Storm.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Fury Storm copy, creating a copy of Fury Storm, targeting the original Fury Storm.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Fury Storm copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.
223-2655-7411.notes: If you've cast your commander this game, Fury Storm will create additional copies of itself as it enters. Each of those copies can result in an extra copy of Gravitic Punch if desired.

457-489-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-489-1792-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Nylea.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3151-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Elves.

489-586-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4682-4772-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-4772-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-4772-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2060-2092-5140-7061.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-5140-7061.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

132-2024-3053.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control

1170-1329-3518-4785.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-3499.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

522-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

2034-2279-2557-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-2557-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2173-2438-5220-6559.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4498-4826-6712.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
4498-4826-6712.notes: It is strongly recommended to perform this combo once you have the highest life total to end the game. It is, however, not a requirement.

1170-2397-3389-5954-6763.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2512-3140-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Soltari Guerrillas ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

813-2103-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Flicker of Fate.
813-2103-3563.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

575-1184-2482-2653.description:
Activate Evolutionary Leap by paying {G} and sacrificing Kin-Tree Warden.
When Kin-Tree Warden dies, Yedora triggers, returning Kin-Tree Warden from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Kin-Tree Warden enters the battlefield, Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Evolutionary Leap ability, causing you to reveal a creature card from your library and put it into your hand.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kin-Tree Warden's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Repeat.

1978-2364-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1978-2364-3007.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Toymaker.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

526-1235-1621.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1235-1621.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Wispweaver Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

2645-4657-4974.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2645-4657-4974.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Zendikar Resurgent's first ability triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3908.notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3908.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3908.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

136-2732-4314-5173-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
136-2732-4314-5173-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia four times by sacrificing Cadaver Imp, Shambling Ghast, Pawn of Ulamog and another nontoken creature.
Pawn of Ulamog and Prowling Geistsnatcher trigger four times each, and Shambling Ghast triggers once.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve all Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Resolve all Prowling Geistsnatcher triggers, exiling the sacrificed creatures.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creatures' powers.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing  Prowling Geistsnatcher.
Prowling Geistsnatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Cadaver Imp enters the battlefield, returning Prowling Geistsnatcher from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 7, causing target player to mill cards equal to Prowling Geistsnatcher's power.
Activate three Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Prowling Geistsnatcher by paying {3}{B}.
Repeat.

633-4499-4659.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control have at least two abilities listed by Odric.
633-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Odric.
Odric enters the battlefield, creating at least two Blood tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Blood tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2396-4106-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Ophidian Eye attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
2396-4106-4869.description:
Activate Aquamoeba by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Ophidian Eye triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

406-1525-4179-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout is paired with Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
406-1525-4179-4298.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving all creature you control +1/+1, trample, and infect untile end of turn.
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Borborygmos triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat from step 2.
